def _process_text(block: 'BlockParser', text: str, loose: bool) ->List[Any]:
    text = TRIM_RE.sub('', text)
    text = strip_end(text)
    if loose:
        children, state = block.parse(text, {})
        return children
    else:
        children, state = block.parse(text, {})
        result = []
        for tok in children:
            if tok.get('type') == 'paragraph':
                result.append({'type': 'inline', 'raw': tok.get('raw', tok.get('text', ''))})
            else:
                result.append(tok)
        return result
